lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Good day, Tenerife! You're listening to Radio Tenerify, and it is a gorgeous Wednesday out there — clear skies, twenty-six degrees. Classic summer on the island.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Honestly, perfect beach weather. And if you're looking for something to do this weekend, there is a lot going on in Santa Cruz!

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Starting Saturday — the Urban Beach Festival at the Puerto de Santa Cruz. Colombian artist Beéle is bringing his Borondo Tour to the island, which is going to be a brilliant night.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: And then Sunday, Kapo plays his very first Tenerife show at the Parking del Palmetum. First time on the island — that's a big deal for his fans here.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Two big concerts, back to back. Check the webtenerife website for tickets and details on both.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Now, we should mention — there have been some serious incidents across the Canaries in recent weeks, including some tragic accidents involving tourists. We won't go into detail, but just a reminder to everyone to stay safe, take care on the roads, and look out for each other.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Well said. Enjoy this beautiful Wednesday, Tenerife — we'll see you back here soon!
